name: Boss Energy Limited
content: Boss Energy Limited is an Australian-based uranium producer focused on the development and operation of its flagship Honeymoon Uranium Project in South Australia. As one of the few permitted uranium mines in Australia, the company utilizes in-situ recovery (ISR) technology to extract uranium oxide. Boss Energy is committed to becoming a significant global uranium supplier, leveraging its high-grade resources and existing infrastructure to meet the growing international demand for clean, carbon-free nuclear energy. The company also holds strategic interests in uranium exploration projects across Australia and North America.

Officers

Duncan CraibJanuary 2017

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Craib is a highly experienced mining executive with over 20 years’ experience in the mining industry. He was previously Finance Director of Swakop Uranium (Pty) Ltd and was involved in the US$2.5 billion development of the Husab Uranium Project in Namibia.

James MarshJanuary 2023

General Manager - Operations

Mr. Marsh is a qualified industrial chemist with over 30 years’ experience in the mining and mineral processing industry. He has held senior positions with several major global companies including Rio Tinto and WMC Resources.

Loz JohnsonJanuary 2022

General Manager - Geology

Mr. Johnson is a geologist with over 25 years’ experience in the mining industry, specifically in uranium exploration and development. He has held senior roles with several uranium companies including Paladin Energy.

Mathew O'HaraJanuary 2023

Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary

Mr. O'Hara is a Chartered Accountant with over 15 years’ experience in corporate finance, accounting and governance. He has held senior positions with several ASX-listed companies.

Non-Executive Director

Mr. Jones is an industrial chemist with over 20 years’ experience in the mining industry, specifically in uranium. He is also a director of several other ASX-listed companies.
